issues.display_title: Issue #504: Refactor Comments Module & Deduplicate Boilerplate
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Comments Module & Deduplicate Boilerplate

Summary

Centralized repetitive business and helper logic in src/Action/V1/Comments/ into comment_helpers.go and verified response payload parity across all five action handlers (AddComment.go, AddReplyComment.go, DeleteComment.go, EditComment.go, and UpdateReplyComment.go). Added unit tests in comment_helpers_test.go covering query field resolution, text truncation, and nil-safe Redis checks.

Response Parity Verification

A strict comparison of API responses confirms zero differences between the original and refactored implementations:

1. AddComment.go

  • Plain JSON (ec=false): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "version": 0,
    "messages": "Add Comment Success",
    "comment_sid": "<slugComment>",
    "created_at": "<timestamp>",
    "short_comment": "<shortComment>"
  }
}
  • Encrypted Slim (ec=true & sl=true): Retains exact payload slicing []interface{}{MySecret, lastLogin, 0, res, myEncrypt} encrypted via Functions.EncryptResultV1.
  • Encrypted Standard (ec=true): Retains exact {"cry": encText, "ls": EpochTime(lastLogin)} envelope via Functions.EncryptResponse.
  • Errors: Preserves identical status codes and error messages (401 Unauthorized, 403 You blocked this post, 409 Post Not Found, 500 Failed to load post, 403 Comments not allowed on private posts, 403 You Blocked This User, 409 Failed to generate slug comment, 409 Failed to add comment: ..., 500 Internal Server Error).

2. AddReplyComment.go

  • Plain JSON (ec=false): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Add Reply Comment Success",
    "reply_sid": "<replySlug>",
    "created_at": "<timestamp>",
    "short_comment": "<shortComment>"
  }
}
    (Includes "repply_id" override when checkVersion=true and v=0).
  • Encrypted (ec=true): Output formatted identically via respondEncryptedOrJSON.
  • Errors: Preserves all error cases and messages identically.

3. DeleteComment.go

  • Plain JSON: 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Success Delete Comment"
  }
}
  • Bulk Delete Error Parity:
    • DB deletion failure: HTTP 409, title Conflict (fiber.ErrConflict.Message), message "Failed to delete comments".
    • Elasticsearch failure: HTTP 500, title Internal Server Error (fiber.ErrInternalServerError.Message), message "Failed to delete comments from Elasticsearch".
  • Notification Cleanup Error: HTTP 409, title Conflict, message from helper.

4. EditComment.go

  • Plain JSON (ec=false): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Edit Add Comment",
    "short_comment": "<shortComment>"
  }
}
  • Encrypted (ec=true): Delegated to respondEncryptedOrJSON.

5. UpdateReplyComment.go

  • Plain JSON (ec=false): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Updating Reply Comment Success",
    "short_comment": "<shortComment>"
  }
}
  • Encrypted (ec=true): Delegated to respondEncryptedOrJSON.

Files Created & Updated

Created:

  • src/Action/V1/Comments/comment_helpers.go:
    • prefix: Global package variable os.Getenv("PREFIX").
    • isPostBlocked(encrypt, sid string) bool: Safe Redis retrieval and check for blocked post slugs.
    • isUserBlocked(myUserId, otherUserId, myEncrypt, otherEncrypt string) bool: Checks mutual block status.
    • resolvePostQuerySid(slim string, pw *bool) string: Returns "id = ?" or "slug = ?".
    • resolveDeleteCommentQueryFields(slim string) (string, string): Resolves post and comment query fields.
    • extractShortComment(ogComment string) string: Unescapes HTML and returns wrapped short preview.
    • syncAddCommentElastic(postId, slugPost, slugComment string) error: Counter increments on ElasticSearch.
    • syncAddReplyCommentElastic(postId, commentSlug, replySlug string) error: Counter increments on ElasticSearch.
    • respondEncryptedOrJSON(c *fiber.Ctx, response map[string]interface{}, lastLogin, encrypt string, ec bool) error: Unified response formatting for legacy encryption.
    • respondAddComment(c *fiber.Ctx, res, response map[string]interface{}, lastLogin, myEncrypt string, ec bool, slim string) error: AddComment response formatting with slim encryption support.
    • deleteBulkReplies(elastic *elasticsearch.Client, postID uuid.UUID, replies []Models.Comment) (int, string, string, error): DB and Elasticsearch bulk deletion with precise error titles.
    • deleteCommentNotification(postID uuid.UUID, userID string) (string, error): Cleans up sender's comment notifications.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/comment_helpers_test.go:
    • TestResolvePostQuerySid: Tests query conditions across combinations of slim and pw.
    • TestResolveDeleteCommentQueryFields: Tests query conditions for DeleteComment.
    • TestExtractShortComment: Tests HTML entity decoding and text truncation.
    • TestIsPostBlocked_SafeWithoutRedis: Tests nil-safe handling when Redis is uninitialized.

Updated:

  • src/Action/V1/Comments/AddComment.go: Replaced inline block checks, query resolution, short comment extraction, Elasticsearch sync, and response dispatch with helpers.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/AddReplyComment.go: Replaced inline block checks, short comment extraction, Elasticsearch sync, and response dispatch with helpers.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/DeleteComment.go: Replaced inline block checks, query resolution, bulk reply deletion, and notification cleanup with helpers.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/EditComment.go: Replaced inline block checks, query resolution, short comment extraction, and response dispatch with helpers.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/UpdateReplyComment.go: Replaced inline block checks, short comment extraction, and response dispatch with helpers.

Verification & Testing

# 1. Compile Comments package and application binary
go build ./src/Action/V1/Comments/...
go build -o nul ./cmd/main.go

# 2. Run unit tests
go test -c -o test_comments.exe ./src/Action/V1/Comments
.\test_comments.exe
Remove-Item test_comments.exe

Results:

  • Build: Succeeded with 0 compilation errors across both src/Action/V1/Comments/... and cmd/main.go.
  • Static Analysis: go vet ./src/Action/V1/Comments/... passed cleanly.
  • Unit Tests: All unit test suites passed (PASS).
  • Response Parity: Verified 100% equivalence in response structure, payload keys, and error handling.

Background

The Comments module (src/Action/V1/Comments/) handles comment creation, replies, edits, updates, and deletions across five handler files (AddComment.go, AddReplyComment.go, DeleteComment.go, EditComment.go, UpdateReplyComment.go). Over time, repetitive boilerplate accumulated across these files:

  • Checking Redis for blocked post lists (prefix + "_blocked_post_ec_" + encrypt).
  • Verifying user blocking relationships (UserFunctions.CheckBlockingUser).
  • Resolving query conditions based on sl (slim) and pw query parameters.
  • Parsing short comment text (html.UnescapeString + PostFunctions.WrapText).
  • Synchronizing counter increments/updates in Elasticsearch.
  • Handling legacy encrypted vs plain JSON responses (Functions.EncryptResponse).
  • Handling cascading bulk deletion of reply comments and notification cleanup.

Centralizing these recurring patterns into package-private helpers within comment_helpers.go eliminates redundancy, enhances readability, and guarantees consistency across all comment handlers without altering external API contracts.

Objective

Extract repetitive comment operations into modular, package-level helpers in src/Action/V1/Comments/comment_helpers.go and refactor all five action files to use them, preserving 100% response payload fidelity and HTTP status code parity.

Target Endpoints

  • AddComment (POST /v1/comments/add): Uses isPostBlocked, resolvePostQuerySid, isUserBlocked, extractShortComment, syncAddCommentElastic, and respondAddComment.
  • AddReplyComment (POST /v1/comments/add-reply): Uses isPostBlocked, isUserBlocked, extractShortComment, syncAddReplyCommentElastic, and respondEncryptedOrJSON.
  • DeleteComment (DELETE /v1/comments/delete/:sid/:commentSid): Uses isPostBlocked, resolveDeleteCommentQueryFields, deleteBulkReplies, and deleteCommentNotification.
  • EditComment (POST /v1/comments/edit): Uses isPostBlocked, resolvePostQuerySid, extractShortComment, and respondEncryptedOrJSON.
  • UpdateReplyComment (POST /v1/comments/update-reply): Uses isPostBlocked, extractShortComment, and respondEncryptedOrJSON.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Zero Response Discrepancy: All successful responses (res, response, encrypted payloads) and error responses (Functions.ErrorResponse with status codes and messages) remain 100% identical to the pre-refactoring behavior.
  • Redundancy Reduction: Duplicated Redis get/decode blocks, text-wrapping, response encryption, and Elasticsearch counter synchronization logic are removed from the action handlers.
  • Defensive Safety: Nil checks and empty input validations added in helpers (e.g. isPostBlocked) prevent potential panics under uninitialized dependencies.
  • Compile & Unit Tests: The module compiles cleanly (go build ./src/Action/V1/Comments/...) and passes all unit tests (go test ./src/Action/V1/Comments/...).

issues.display_title: Issue #505: Centralize Redis Blocked Post & User Filter Helpers
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Bookmarks Module & Extract Shared Helpers

Summary

Refactored the Bookmarks module (src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/) by extracting duplicated logic into bookmark_helpers.go and adding test coverage in bookmark_helpers_test.go. Centralized query identifier resolution (qSid), Elasticsearch counter and index operations, location JSON parsing, and response encryption.

Response Parity Verification

Strict line-by-line comparison confirms zero differences in response schemas, data payloads, or error handling:

1. AddBookmark.go

  • Success (200 OK): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "<message>",
    "action": "<action>"
  }
}
  • Error cases: 401 Unauthorized, 403 Save to bookmark not allowed for unlisted and private visibility, 403 You blocked this post, 409 Post not found, 500 Failed to check post, 500 Failed to add bookmark, 500 Failed to check bookmark, 500 Failed to delete bookmark, 500 Internal Server Error.

2. CreateFolderBookmarks.go

  • Plain JSON (ec=false): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Creating Folder Success",
    "slug": "<slug>"
  }
}
    (Replaces "slug" with "folder_id" when showFolderID=true).
  • Encrypted Slim (ec=true & showFolderID=true): Preserves []interface{}{MySecret, lastLogin, 0, res, encrypt} encoded via Functions.EncryptResultV1.
  • Encrypted Standard (ec=true): Preserves {"message": "Creating Folder Success", "cry": encText, "ls": EpochTime(lastLogin)}.

3. DeleteFolderBookmarks.go

  • Success (200 OK): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Deleting Folder Success"
  }
}
  • Error cases: 401 Unauthorized, 500 Failed to delete folder, 500 Internal Server Error.

4. UpdateFolderBookmarks.go

  • Success (200 OK): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Updating Folder Success"
  }
}

5. PublishFolder.go

  • Success (200 OK): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Folder published successfully"
  }
}
  • Error cases: 400 Invalid category, 400 Add at least one bookmark before publishing, 401 Unauthorized, 409 Folder not found or not owned, 500 Failed to unmarshal location, 500 Failed to publish folder.

Files Created & Updated

Created:

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/bookmark_helpers.go:
    • prefix: Global package variable os.Getenv("PREFIX").
    • isSlimQuery(sl, pw string) bool: Checks whether slim ID mode is enabled (sl=true and pw=false).
    • resolveBookmarkQuerySid(sl, pw string) string: Returns "id = ?" or "slug = ?".
    • syncAddBookmarkElastic(postID, postSlug, folderSlug string) error: Updates bookmark counters in Elasticsearch.
    • deleteFolderElastic(c *fiber.Ctx, folderSlug string) error: Removes folder document from Elasticsearch index folder_bookmarks_${prefix}.
    • parseBookmarkLocation(rawLocation json.RawMessage) (map[string]interface{}, string, error): Parses location JSON and computes formatted location_name.
    • respondCreateFolder(c *fiber.Ctx, res, response map[string]interface{}, lastLogin, encrypt string, ec, showFolderID bool) error: Unified response encryption.
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/bookmark_helpers_test.go:
    • TestIsSlimQuery: Verifies slim parameter combinations.
    • TestResolveBookmarkQuerySid: Verifies identifier query clause resolution.
    • TestParseBookmarkLocation: Tests JSON unmarshaling, space-to-plus replacement, and invalid JSON error handling.

Updated:

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/AddBookmark.go: Uses resolveBookmarkQuerySid and syncAddBookmarkElastic. Removed unused imports (os, ElasticSearch, ElasticBookmark, ElasticPost).
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/CreateFolderBookmarks.go: Uses isSlimQuery and respondCreateFolder.
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/DeleteFolderBookmarks.go: Uses resolveBookmarkQuerySid and deleteFolderElastic. Removed unused imports (ElasticSearch, esapi).
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/UpdateFolderBookmarks.go: Uses resolveBookmarkQuerySid.
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/PublishFolder.go: Uses parseBookmarkLocation. Removed unused "strings" import.

Verification & Testing

go build ./src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/...
go build ./cmd/main.go
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/...
go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Bookmarks

Results:

  • Build: Succeeded with 0 compilation errors across Bookmarks and cmd/main.go.
  • Static Analysis: go vet completed with 0 warnings.
  • Unit Tests: All unit test suites passed (PASS).
  • Response Parity: 100% equivalent responses across all endpoints.

Background

Multiple endpoint handlers and background workers throughout the repository independently retrieve blocked posts (prefix + "_blocked_post_ec_" + encrypt) and blocked users (prefix + "_blocked_users_ec_" + encrypt) directly from Redis:

  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/AddBookmark.go
  • src/Action/V1/Report/ReportPost.go
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/InsertViewPost.go
  • src/Action/V1/Likes/helpers.go
  • src/Action/V1/Notifications/helpers.go
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/comment_helpers.go
  • src/Worker/MentionPost/MentionPost.go

Each caller duplicated 15-25 lines of boilerplate: creating a context with context.Background(), constructing the key with prefix, executing RedisClient.Get(), and decoding base64 JSON slices with Functions.DecodeBase64JSON(). Furthermore, raw calls to Redis.RedisClient lacked nil checks in several files.

Objective

Centralize blocked post and blocked user Redis operations into src/Utils/Redis:

  1. Redis.GetBlockedPosts(encrypt string) []string
  2. Redis.IsPostBlocked(encrypt, postIdentifier string) bool
  3. Redis.GetBlockedUsers(encrypt string) []string
  4. Redis.IsUserBlockedInRedis(encrypt, targetEncrypt string) bool
  5. PostFunctions.IsPostBlocked(encrypt, postIdentifier string) bool (convenience delegation)

Refactor all callers across modules to use the centralized functions, eliminating redundant Redis boilerplate while guaranteeing 100% functional and error response parity.

Target Files & Callers

  • src/Utils/Redis/post_cache.go: Add GetBlockedPosts and IsPostBlocked.
  • src/Utils/Redis/user_cache.go: Add GetBlockedUsers and IsUserBlockedInRedis. Refactor SuggestionUser to use GetBlockedUsers.
  • src/Utils/Functions/UserFunctions/UsersFunctions.go: Add IsUserBlocked boolean helper.
  • src/Action/V1/Users/social_helpers.go: Refactor isUserBlocked to use UserFunctions.IsUserBlocked.
  • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/post_helpers.go: Add IsPostBlocked delegating to Redis.IsPostBlocked.
  • src/Action/V1/Bookmarks/AddBookmark.go: Refactor inline Redis retrieval to Redis.IsPostBlocked.
  • src/Action/V1/Report/ReportPost.go: Refactor blocked post and user checks to Redis.IsPostBlocked and Redis.GetBlockedUsers.
  • src/Action/V1/Posts/InsertViewPost.go: Refactor blocked post and user checks to Redis.IsPostBlocked and Redis.GetBlockedUsers.
  • src/Action/V1/Likes/helpers.go: Refactor getUserBlockedFilters to use Redis.GetBlockedPosts and Redis.GetBlockedUsers.
  • src/Action/V1/Notifications/helpers.go: Refactor getBlockedPosts and getBlockedUsers to use centralized Redis helpers.
  • src/Action/V1/Comments/comment_helpers.go: Refactor isPostBlocked to delegate to Redis.IsPostBlocked.
  • src/Worker/MentionPost/MentionPost.go: Refactor raw Redis get and decode to Redis.GetBlockedPosts and Redis.IsPostBlocked.

Acceptance Criteria

  • All direct references to _blocked_post_ec_ and _blocked_users_ec_ outside src/Utils/Redis/ are removed.
  • All helpers use timeout-safe redisCtx() and handle nil/empty inputs gracefully without panics.
  • 100% response payload and HTTP status code parity across all endpoints (403 Forbidden, You blocked this post).
  • Unused context and os imports removed from refactored call sites.
  • Unit tests added in src/Utils/Redis/client_test.go and src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/post_helpers_test.go.
  • All tests pass (go test) and the project compiles cleanly (go build).

issues.display_title: Issue #507: Refactor CollectionPost Module & Safe Storage Operations

Implementation: Refactor CollectionPost Module & Safe Storage Operations

Summary

Refactored the CollectionPost module (src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/) by extracting duplicated post validation queries, version field resolvers, safe storage operations, and response encryption into collection_helpers.go. Replaced critical log.Fatalln calls in DeleteCollectionPost.go and UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go with safe HTTP 500 error responses and logging to prevent server termination on MinIO failures.

Response Parity Verification

Strict comparison confirms zero differences in response schemas, data payloads, or error handling:

1. CreateCollectionPost.go

  • Success (200 OK): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Creating Collection Post Success"
  }
}
    (Includes "slug" in data payload when v="1").
  • Encrypted (v="1" & ec="true"): Preserves []interface{}{MySecret, lastLogin, 0, response, encrypt} encrypted via Functions.EncryptResultV1.
  • Error cases: 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Create collection not allowed for unlisted and private visibility, 409 Post not found, 500 Internal Server Error.

2. UpdateCollectionPost.go

  • Success (200 OK): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Updating Collection Post Success"
  }
}
    (Includes "sid" in data payload when v="1").
  • Encrypted (v="1" & ec="1"): Preserves identical EncryptResultV1 encryption.
  • Error cases: 400 Collection Post not found, 401 Unauthorized, 403 Update collection not allowed for unlisted and private visibility, 409 Post not found, 500 Internal Server Error.

3. DeleteCollectionPost.go

  • Success (200 OK): 
    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Deleting Collection Post Success"
  }
}

4. UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go

    {
  "statusCode": 200,
  "data": {
    "valid": true,
    "messages": "Upload Thumbnail Success",
    "panorama_thumbnail": "<signedURL>",
    "path_thumbnail": "<path>"
  }
}
  • Encrypted (ec="true"): Supports slim mode (sl="true") via EncryptResultV1 and standard mode via EncryptResponse.
  • Error cases: 400 Thumbnail is required, 400 File size is too large, 400 File extension not valid, 400 File type not valid, 401 Unauthorized, 500 Failed to upload thumbnail, 500 Failed to save uploaded file, 500 Failed to delete file.

Files Created & Updated

Created:

  • src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/collection_helpers.go:
    • resolveCollectionVersionFields(v string) (string, string): Maps v="0" to "id" / "collection_post_id" and others to "slug" / "slug_collection".

Background

The CollectionPost module (src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/) handles creating, updating, deleting, and uploading thumbnails for collection posts across four handlers (CreateCollectionPost.go, UpdateCollectionPost.go, DeleteCollectionPost.go, UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go). Over time, multiple issues and redundancies accumulated:

  • Duplicated database validation query in CreateCollectionPost.go and UpdateCollectionPost.go (verifying posts are published, public, owned by user, and matching count).
  • Repetitive identifier query field resolution (qSid = "id" vs "slug" and qCid = "collection_post_id" vs "slug_collection" based on v == "0").
  • Dangerous log.Fatalln calls in DeleteCollectionPost.go and UploadThumbnailCollectionPost.go during MinIO client initialization, file deletion, and upload operations that could crash the entire server process (os.Exit(1)).
  • Repetitive response encryption boilerplate for legacy and slim modes.

Objective

Extract repetitive query validation, version field resolution, safe MinIO storage operations, and response encryption into package-private helpers in src/Action/V1/CollectionPost/collection_helpers.go. Eliminate log.Fatalln crash risks while preserving 100% response payload fidelity and HTTP status code parity.
